Card Q&A.a: Yes, you gain 2 memory if both of the conditions are met.
Card Q&A.q: Do I gain 2 memory for this card’s [Start of Your Turn] effect if both me and my opponent have 3 or fewer security cards?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, gain 1 memory. If your opponent has 3 or fewer security cards, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When one of your red or yellow Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Tamer to have all of your opponent’s Security Digimon get -2000 DP for the turn.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
